propositions: recheck-review refuses all current-revision findings including bugfix-size-attestation, but that finding's remedy is ticket-side (earning plan-review attestation) not code change

when a change carries a stale bugfix-size-attestation finding and the ticket later earns a valid plan-review attestation, NO_CODE_CHANGE label copy prevents recheck-review or rebase from recomputing the gate verdict

recheck-review should accept bugfix-size-attestation blocks when the ticket's plan-review attestation buckets as accepted, by reading the bot's vote message and re-classifying with the gate's own verifier

eligibility for bugfix-size-attestation re-review must read only bot vote and ticket store (not the requesting comment), verify exactly one blocking finding exists, and refuse on attestation absence, stale-material, or infra verdicts
